LESSON 14 / 37 • ORIGINAL CHECKLIST
Position: static, relative, absolute,
fixed, sticky

Position determines how a box is placed relative to normal flow, a containing block, the viewport
or a scrolling container.
Static normal flow එJකේ තිJයනවා. Relative එක තමන්Jගේ මුල් position එJකන් offset කරනවා, මුල්
ඉඩ තියාගන්නවා. Absolute flow එJකන් ඉවතේ Jවලා containing block එක අනුව තුන්පෙතේ Jවනවා.
Fixed සාමාන්‍යJයන් viewport එකට සම්බන්ධයි. Sticky එක scroll කරනJකාට inset එකකට ළඟා
වුණාම scroll container එක ඇතුJළේ රැJඳනවා.
A card badge, floating support button and sticky navigation.
static · relative · absolute · fixed · sticky · nav · badge · box · box · help

Read the diagram: 1. A relative parent establishes the badge’s containing block. 2. Absolute badge
does not reserve normal-flow space. 3. Fixed button stays on screen. 4. Sticky nav stays at the
threshold while its container permits it.
Relative box එක මුල් තුJනන් Jවනස් Jවනවා. Absolute badge එක parent එකටතේ fixed help button එක

Expected result: Badge anchors to card; help normally anchors to viewport; nav sticks within its
scroll constraints.
Interview question: Relative vs absolute positioning?

Answer: Relative keeps its original flow space; absolute is out of flow and uses its containing
block.
Remember: Relative parent anchors absolute child.
Practice: Make a card with a top-right badge and a sticky header.
